course.title: Unit 2 I’ll help to clean up the city parks.【例句】

sentences.content: I've run out of it.
sentences.english: I've run out of it
sentences.chinese: 我已经用完了。

sentences.content: I take after my mother.
sentences.english: I take after my mother
sentences.chinese: 我随我母亲。

sentences.content: I fixed it up.
sentences.english: I fixed it up
sentences.chinese: 我把它修好了。

sentences.content: I gave it away.
sentences.english: I gave it away
sentences.chinese: 我把它送人了。

sentences.content: I gave away my bike to a children's home.
sentences.english: I gave away my bike to a children's home
sentences.chinese: 我把自行车捐给了一家儿童福利院。

sentences.content: This morning I'm talking with a very wonderful young man, Jimmy the Bike Boy. Good morning, Jimmy.
sentences.english: This morning I'm talking with a very wonderful young man , Jimmy the Bike Boy . Good morning , Jimmy
sentences.chinese: 今天早上，我正在和一位非常出色的年轻人交谈，单车男孩Jimmy。早上好，Jimmy。

sentences.content: Good morning.
sentences.english: Good morning
sentences.chinese: 早上好。

sentences.content: So, Jimmy, tell our listeners what you do.
sentences.english: So , Jimmy , tell our listeners what you do
sentences.chinese: 那么，Jimmy，跟我们的听众说说你是做什么的。

sentences.content: Well, many kids don't have enough money to buy their own bikes.
sentences.english: Well , many kids don't have enough money to buy their own bikes
sentences.chinese: 嗯，很多孩子没有足够的钱买自己的自行车。

sentences.content: So I find or buy old bikes. Sometimes parts like the wheels may be broken.
sentences.english: So I find or buy old bikes . Sometimes parts like the wheels may be broken
sentences.chinese: 所以我寻找或购买旧自行车。有时候像车轮这样的部件可能是坏的。

sentences.content: So I fix up the bikes and then give them away to these kids.
sentences.english: So I fix up the bikes and then give them away to these kids
sentences.chinese: 于是我把这些自行车修好，然后送给那些孩子们。

sentences.content: That's fantastic. What gave you the idea?
sentences.english: That's fantastic . What gave you the idea ?
sentences.chinese: 太棒了。你是怎么想到这个主意的？

sentences.content: I guess I take after my father. He loves to help people.
sentences.english: I guess I take after my father . He loves to help people
sentences.chinese: 我想我随我父亲。他乐于助人。

sentences.content: He always volunteers to help people in need.
sentences.english: He always volunteers to help people in need
sentences.chinese: 他总是主动帮助有需要的人。

wordDetails.definition: volunteer（第三人称单数）: 自愿

sentences.content: Wow! Your parents must be proud of you.
sentences.english: Wow ! Your parents must be proud of you
sentences.chinese: 哇！你的父母一定为你感到骄傲。

sentences.content: I guess so. But now I've run out of money, so I can't buy any more old bikes.
sentences.english: I guess so . But now I've run out of money , so I can't buy any more old bikes
sentences.chinese: 我想是吧。但现在我的钱花光了，所以没法再买旧自行车了。

sentences.content: Oh, that's too bad.
sentences.english: Oh , that's too bad
sentences.chinese: 哦，那太糟糕了。

sentences.content: Yeah. I need to come up with some way of getting money or I'll have to stop.
sentences.english: Yeah . I need to come up with some way of getting money or I'll have to stop
sentences.chinese: 是啊。我得想办法搞点钱，不然就只能停手了。

sentences.content: Dear Miss Li, I'd like to thank you for giving money to Animal Helpers.
sentences.english: Dear Miss Li , I'd like to thank you for giving money to Animal Helpers
sentences.chinese: 亲爱的Li小姐，感谢您为Animal Helpers捐款。

sentences.content: I'm sure you know that this group was set up to help disabled people like me.
sentences.english: I'm sure you know that this group was set up to help disabled people like me
sentences.chinese: 我相信你知道，成立这个小组是为了帮助像我这样的残疾人。

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

sentences.content: You helped to make it possible for me to have Lucky.
sentences.english: You helped to make it possible for me to have Lucky
sentences.chinese: 多亏有你帮忙，我才能拥有Lucky。

sentences.content: Lucky makes a big difference to my life. Let me tell you my story.
sentences.english: Lucky makes a big difference to my life . Let me tell you my story
sentences.chinese: Lucky给我的生活带来了巨大改变。让我来讲讲我的故事。

sentences.content: What would it be like to be blind or deaf?
sentences.english: What would it be like to be blind or deaf ?
sentences.chinese: 失明或失聪会是什么感觉？

wordDetails.definition: will（过去式）: 表示假设或意愿

sentences.content: Or imagine you can't walk or use your hands easily.
sentences.english: Or imagine you can't walk or use your hands easily
sentences.chinese: 或者想象一下你无法自如行走或用手。

sentences.content: Most people would never think about this,
sentences.english: Most people would never think about this
sentences.chinese: 大多数人根本不会想到这一点，

sentences.content: but many people have these difficulties.
sentences.english: but many people have these difficulties
sentences.chinese: 但许多人都有这些困难。

sentences.content: I can't use my arms or legs well, so normal things like answering the telephone,
sentences.english: I can't use my arms or legs well , so normal things like answering the telephone
sentences.chinese: 我的手臂和腿脚不太灵便，所以像接电话这类平常事，

sentences.content: opening and closing doors, or carrying things are difficult for me.
sentences.english: opening and closing doors , or carrying things are difficult for me
sentences.chinese: 开门关门或搬东西对我来说都很困难。

sentences.content: Then one day last year, a friend of mine helped me out.
sentences.english: Then one day last year , a friend of mine helped me out
sentences.chinese: 直到去年某天，我的一位朋友出手相助。

sentences.content: She talked to Animal Helpers about getting me a special trained dog.
sentences.english: She talked to Animal Helpers about getting me a special trained dog
sentences.chinese: 她与Animal Helpers商讨为我配备一只经过特殊训练的狗。

wordDetails.definition: train（过去分词）: 受过训练的

sentences.content: She also thought a dog might cheer me up.
sentences.english: She also thought a dog might cheer me up
sentences.chinese: 她还觉得养条狗或许能让我开心起来。

sentences.content: I love animals and I was excited about the idea of having a dog.
sentences.english: I love animals and I was excited about the idea of having a dog
sentences.chinese: 我热爱动物，对于养狗这个想法感到非常兴奋。

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

sentences.content: After six months of training with a dog at Animal Helpers,
sentences.english: After six months of training with a dog at Animal Helpers
sentences.chinese: 在Animal Helpers与一只狗共同训练了六个月后，

sentences.content: I was able to bring him home.
sentences.english: I was able to bring him home
sentences.chinese: 我成功把他带回了家。

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

sentences.content: My dog's name is Lucky — a good name for him because I feel very lucky to have him.
sentences.english: My dog's name is Lucky — a good name for him because I feel very lucky to have him
sentences.chinese: 我的狗叫Lucky——这个名字很适合它，因为我觉得有它陪伴非常幸运。

sentences.content: You see, I'm only able to have a "dog helper" because of your kindness!
sentences.english: You see , I'm only able to have a " dog helper " because of your kindness !
sentences.chinese: 要知道，正是因为你的善心，我才能拥有一位“狗狗助手”！

sentences.content: Lucky is very clever and understands many English words.
sentences.english: Lucky is very clever and understands many English words
sentences.chinese: Lucky非常聪明，能听懂很多英文单词。

wordDetails.definition: understand（第三人称单数）: 理解

sentences.content: He can understand me when I give him orders.
sentences.english: He can understand me when I give him orders
sentences.chinese: 当我给他下达指令时，他能理解我的意思。

sentences.content: For example, I say, "Lucky! Get my book," and he does it at once.
sentences.english: For example , I say ," Lucky ! Get my book ," and he does it at once
sentences.chinese: 例如，我说：“Lucky！把我的书拿来”，他立刻就照做了。

sentences.content: Lucky is a fantastic dog.
sentences.english: Lucky is a fantastic dog
sentences.chinese: Lucky是一只非常棒的狗狗。

sentences.content: I'll send you a photo of him if you like,
sentences.english: I'll send you a photo of him if you like
sentences.chinese: 如果你愿意的话，我会发一张他的照片给你，

sentences.content: and I could show you how he helps me.
sentences.english: and I could show you how he helps me
sentences.chinese: 我可以向你展示他是如何帮助我的。

wordDetails.definition: help（第三人称单数）: 帮助

sentences.content: Thank you again for changing my life.
sentences.english: Thank you again for changing my life
sentences.chinese: 再次感谢你改变了我的生活。
